answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the ledge check immediately, the jade audit keeps the resolved set and the mirror replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 270 aliases hence pays the reading cost 270 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
